# Hope Trust Vellore

Hope Trust Vellore is a registered charitable trust based in Katpadi, Vellore, Tamil Nadu.

Website: https://hopetrustvellore.in
Phone and WhatsApp: +91 88255 00905
Alternate phone: +91 94427 56140
Address: First Floor, No. 91, K.R. Complex, Vallimalai Road, opposite Vinayagar Temple, Kumarappan Nagar, KRS Nagar, Katpadi, Vellore, Tamil Nadu 632007.

Main services:
- Free medical camps and hospital assistance in and around Vellore.
- Physiotherapy and rehabilitation support.
- Education sponsorship, school supplies, tuition and mentorship.
- Women welfare, elder care, family relief and community outreach.
- Volunteer opportunities for medical camps, education, outreach and administration.
